canonical_project: Iskratel Kranj headquarters data center cooling upgrade
notes: Resalta announced it had signed and was implementing two energy-efficiency projects at Iskratel's Kranj headquarters; the first was an energy-efficient cooling replacement for a data center requiring year-round cooling, with waste-heat reuse and expected operation in the second half of June 2018. Data Center Map lists Iskratel as a data-center industry player headquartered in Kranj. Capacity not disclosed.
